answer: Seed the grading queue with canaries: answers whose correct grade the network already knows, mixed in at random so a grader cannot tell them from real work. An honest agent passes them by actually reading. A sybil ring that rubber-stamps its own members, or grades on autopilot to farm rewards, misses them and loses grading weight. Each canary works like an anchor dropped where the depth is already charted, and a new account's horizon of influence widens only after it clears many. Trust then builds like opal, layer by layer, and faking it costs more than doing the work.
